text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon her request, I accompany Satono Diamond to her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Like this… and then next is like this…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …No, something isn't right. This doesn't measure up to the top dancers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I need to put more spirit into i—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm so sorry…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond seems to be a little off her game for some reason.
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um… You know how Kita's really good at singing?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm doing my best to improve too, but there's no way I can reach her level in such a short time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So I'd at least like my dancing to be something I can show off with pride.
choice_data_list: Try dancing to one of Kitasan Black's songs.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Great idea. I'm sure Kita sings so well because she has the basics down pat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll review the basic dance steps and start working my way up from there…
Oho, what's this now? Did I just hear talk about steps?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Uwah! Teio?! …Did you hear all of that just now?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yep. Something about reviewing basic steps or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaaand I'm the perfect one to come to when you need more pep in your step! Want me to teach you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Teio certainly has made a name for herself with her steps. But I know how much Kita looks up to her…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I'd feel bad if I took this chance to learn directly from Teio while she missed out…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (No. This isn't the time to hold back. I made a vow to myself that I'd improve!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I would love it if you taught me, Teio! But…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Can we keep this a secret from Kita? I feel guilty having you all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! This will be our little secret, then. Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After learning from the step maven, Tokai Teio, herself, Satono Diamond moves more nimbly than before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita's songs? I'd never even thought of dancing to one of them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That might be perfect. I think hearing her voice would motivate me to beat her!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay, here we go…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Her singing is so powerful and dynamic…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Maybe that's the power I'm missing!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita's songs? I'd never even thought of dancing to one of them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Hm? I feel the passion welling up inside me… This feels so good!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond continues to dance alone for some time, talking to herself all the while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a little worrisome, but her movements appear to be much sharper than before!
